title: Document and finalize the dynamic request-directory contract
objective: Define the request-directory layout, asset mapping, parameter syntax, placeholder syntax, processing order, compatibility decisions, and evidence boundary before implementation.

branch.name: llm-request-lookup
branch.rationale: The record captures bounded planning without creating or switching a branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest(requestDirectory, parameters); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation; and no commit.

scope.name: documentation
scope.description: The request-directory contract is documented at requests/README.md.
scope.reason: Implementers and users need one source of truth.

scope.name: prompt-mapping
scope.description: The contract explicitly maps prompt.md and prompt.system.md to existing LlmRequest fields and records summarize compatibility.
scope.reason: Otherwise generic construction can invert task and system instructions.

scope.name: parameter-contract
scope.description: The contract defines direct, nested, indexed, object-valued, full-object, precedence, duplicate, conversion, and schema-validation rules.
scope.reason: Parameter behavior must be deterministic and independently testable.

scope.name: evidence-boundary
scope.description: The contract defines provider-free evidence and explicit non-goals for subsequent work.
scope.reason: Planning must distinguish requirements from implementation claims.

nonGoals.name: implementation
nonGoals.description: Do not implement behavior outside this work item.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated calls, publish, deploy, or claim production readiness.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactor
nonGoals.description: Do not redesign unrelated commands, providers, schemas, or persistence.
nonGoals.reason: Scope is limited to dynamic request lookup.
